title: Bounded intersection-preserving replacement for a set of presheaf monomorphisms
statement:
Fix an input universe $\mathcal U$ as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A$ be a $\mathcal U$-small ordinary category, $\mathcal P=\operatorname{Fun}(A^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Set}_{\mathcal U})$, $B$ any presheaf in $\mathcal P$, and $\Lambda$ a $\mathcal U$-small set of monomorphisms in $\mathcal P$. Let $\operatorname{wsat}(\Lambda)$ denote closure under isomorphisms, pushouts, $\mathcal U$-small transfinite compositions continuous at limits, and retracts in the arrow category. A presheaf $Z$ is $\Lambda$-injective if every map $D\to Z$ extends to $E\to Z$ for every $(D\hookrightarrow E)\in\Lambda$. Write $|F|=|\coprod_{a\in\operatorname{Ob}(A)}F(a)|$ for total-element size.

There exist an endofunctor $R:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P$, a natural transformation $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to R$, and infinite regular cardinals $\lambda<\alpha$ in $\mathcal U$, with $\alpha>|\operatorname{Mor}(A)|$ and $\alpha>|B|$, having all the following properties. Regular means that a union of fewer than the cardinal many sets, each of smaller cardinality, still has smaller cardinality.

(1) Each $\eta_F:F\to R(F)$ belongs to $\operatorname{wsat}(\Lambda)$, and $R(F)$ is $\Lambda$-injective.

(2) The functor $R$ preserves monomorphisms. For any subpresheaves $S,T\subseteq Y$, identify their $R$-images with subpresheaves of $R(Y)$. The canonical map identifies $R(S\cap T)$ with $R(S)\cap R(T)$.

(3) If $|F|<\alpha$, then $|R(F)|<\alpha$ and $|B\times R(F)|<\alpha$.

(4) For every $Y$, the union of $R(T)\subseteq R(Y)$ over all subpresheaves $T\subseteq Y$ with $|T|<\alpha$ is $R(Y)$.

(5) For every increasing family $(T_\xi)_{\xi<\lambda}$ of subpresheaves of $Y$, indexed by the initial ordinal of cardinality $\lambda$, the canonical map identifies $\bigcup_{\xi<\lambda}R(T_\xi)$ with $R(\bigcup_{\xi<\lambda}T_\xi)$ as subpresheaves of $R(Y)$. All these constructions and colimits remain in $\mathcal U$.

source.place: Cisinski, Higher Categories and Homotopical Algebra, construction 2.4.36 and Lemma 2.4.37, printed pp. 64-65 (PDF pp. 79-80). Agent formulation with separate preservation rank lambda and larger size bound alpha, so lambda < alpha; the source gives preservation of sufficiently long unions and small supports. The fixed auxiliary B only increases the size bound. Read online 2026-10-17, not archived in literature/.
